subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw support Browserbase session lifecycle as a first-party browser profile driver, wait for a generic browser-backend plugin seam, or reduce the docs to a limitation/workaround?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses commercial-service integration, browser-control security, config/schema surface, credential handling, signed URL redaction, and session lifecycle policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise Browserbase Driver
options.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after credential policy, signed URL redaction, shared route coverage, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

options.title: Design Generic Backend Seam
options.body: Keep this tied to the broader browser backend/plugin API so Browserbase can ship outside core once a safe registration contract exists.

options.title: Document Limitation
options.body: Remove or narrow the static Browserbase recommendation until maintainers are ready to support Browserbase Sessions API lifecycle in product code.

recommendation.title: Revise Browserbase Driver
recommendation.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after credential policy, signed URL redaction, shared route coverage, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal across the browser plugin boundary and current runtime/docs surface affected by this decision.
